integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at the graded coproduct decomposition, Lemmas 4.7--4.10, Remark 4.11, Proposition 4.13, and Theorem 3.3. The proof replaces disjoint commutator blocks by linearly independent exterior-power basis elements and checks that the source's injectivity and intersection arguments require only that independence. A bundled arithmetic checker corroborates the binomial packing functions and the resulting quantitative bounds.
scientific_limitations: The result is an upper-bound refinement of the source's strict-envelope construction. It does not prove optimality, does not improve the qualitative model-companion theorem, and does not claim analogous packing for other exponents.
title: Exterior-power packing makes exponent-three strict envelopes near-linear
